# Music Assistant — full API reference

Generated from the live OpenAPI document. Schemas use JSON Schema notation.

## GET /api/artists

List tracked bands

Response 200: Tracked bands with plan/disk counts

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "artists": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "mbid": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "disambig": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "score": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "catalogSize": {
            "type": [
              "number",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "quota": {
            "type": [
              "number",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "pinnedMbid": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "ignored": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "createdAt": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "planCount": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "onDiskCount": {
            "type": "number"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "mbid",
          "name",
          "disambig",
          "score",
          "catalogSize",
          "quota",
          "pinnedMbid",
          "ignored",
          "createdAt",
          "planCount",
          "onDiskCount"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "artists"
  ]
}
```

## POST /api/artists

Track a band: resolve, compute quota, build plan, reconcile

Request body (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "mbid": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "score": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 3
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ]
}
```

Response 201: Band tracked and planned

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "artist": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "mbid": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "disambig": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "score": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "catalogSize": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "quota": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pinnedMbid": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "ignored": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "createdAt": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "mbid",
        "name",
        "disambig",
        "score",
        "catalogSize",
        "quota",
        "pinnedMbid",
        "ignored",
        "createdAt"
      ]
    },
    "catalog": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "albums": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "catalog": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "method": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "albums",
        "catalog",
        "method"
      ]
    },
    "sync": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "applied": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "desired": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "rank": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "title": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "norm": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "pinned": {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "rank",
              "title",
              "norm",
              "pinned"
            ]
          }
        },
        "acquire": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "rank": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "title": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "norm": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "pinned": {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "rank",
              "title",
              "norm",
              "pinned"
            ]
          }
        },
        "retire": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "fileName": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "fileName"
            ]
          }
        },
        "renames": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "from": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "to": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "from",
              "to"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "applied",
        "desired",
        "acquire",
        "retire",
        "renames"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "artist",
    "catalog",
    "sync"
  ]
}
```

Response 400: Bad request

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```

## DELETE /api/artists/{id}

Untrack a band (files are retired, never deleted)

Response 200: Untracked

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "retired": {
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "retired"
  ]
}
```

```json
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
```

```json
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```

## GET /api/artists/{id}

Band detail with plan rows

Response 200: Band detail

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "artist": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "mbid": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "disambig": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "score": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "catalogSize": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "quota": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pinnedMbid": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "ignored": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "createdAt": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "mbid",
        "name",
        "disambig",
        "score",
        "catalogSize",
        "quota",
        "pinnedMbid",
        "ignored",
        "createdAt"
      ]
    },
    "plan": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "rank": {
            "type": "number"

          "title": {
            "type": "string"

            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string"
          },

            "type": "string"

          "id",

          "title",
          "norm",
          "pinned",
          "status",
          "source"
        ]
      }
    },
    "onDiskCount": {
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "artist",
```

## PATCH /api/artists/{id}

Change the taste tier (re-quota + re-plan immediately)

Request body (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "score": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 3
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "score"
  ]
}
```

Response 200: Updated band with the resulting sync summary

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "artist": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "mbid": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "disambig": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "score": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "catalogSize": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "quota": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pinnedMbid": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "ignored": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "createdAt": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "mbid",
        "name",
        "disambig",
        "score",
        "catalogSize",
        "quota",
        "pinnedMbid",
        "ignored",
        "createdAt"
      ]
    },
    "sync": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "applied": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "desired": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "rank": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "title": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "norm": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "pinned": {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "rank",
              "title",
              "norm",
              "pinned"
            ]
          }
        },
        "acquire": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "rank": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "title": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "norm": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "pinned": {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "rank",
              "title",
              "norm",
              "pinned"
            ]
          }
        },
        "retire": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "fileName": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "fileName"
            ]
          }
        },
        "renames": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "from": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "to": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "from",
              "to"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "applied",
        "desired",
        "acquire",
        "retire",
        "renames"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "artist",
    "sync"
  ]
}
```

## POST /api/artists/{id}/albums

Pin a whole album (MusicBrainz track list)

Request body (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "album": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "album"
  ]
}
```

Response 201: Pinned tracks (already-planned titles are skipped)

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "pinned": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "rank": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "norm": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "rank",
          "title",
          "norm"
        ]
      }
    },
    "skipped": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "pinned",
    "skipped"
  ]
}
```

Response 400: Bad request

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```

Response 404: Not found

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```

Response 409: Conflict

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```

Response 422: Unprocessable

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
```

## POST /api/artists/{id}/sync

Preview (apply=false) or apply the desired-state plan

Request body (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "apply": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

Response 200: Sync result

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "applied": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "desired": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "rank": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "norm": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "pinned": {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "rank",
          "title",
          "norm",
          "pinned"
        ]
      }
    },
    "acquire": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "rank": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "title": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "norm": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "pinned": {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "rank",
          "title",
          "norm",
          "pinned"
        ]
      }
    },
    "retire": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "fileName": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "fileName"
        ]
      }
    },
    "renames": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "from": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "to": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "from",
          "to"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "applied",
    "desired",
    "acquire",
    "retire",
    "renames"
  ]
}
```

## POST /api/artists/{id}/tracks

Pin a track (survives every re-plan)

Request body (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "title"
  ]
}
```

Response 201: Pinned track

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "rank": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "norm": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id",
    "rank",
    "title",
    "norm"
  ]
}
```

Response 400: Bad request

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
```

## POST /api/migrate

Import legacy state (bands.csv + plan.csv) as a durable job

Queues the one-shot importer. The collection is scanned from the server's configured collection directory; files are only read. GET /api/migrate/report returns the outcome once the job finishes.

Request body (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "bandsCsv": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "planCsv": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "bandsCsv"
  ]
}
```

Response 202: Migration queued (jobId null = an identical run is already queued)

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "jobId": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "jobId"
  ]
}
```

Response 422: Validation failed

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```

## POST /api/plan

```json
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "jobId": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
```

```json
            "type": "number"

          "type": "object",

            "type": "number"
```

## POST /api/verify

Deep verify: plan vs disk by normalized title, file name AND content hash

Request body (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "artistId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0
    }
  }
}
```

Response 200: Verify reports (one per band)

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "reports": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "artistId": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "band": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "planCount": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "onDiskCount": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "ok": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "issues": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "type": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "missing",
                    "surplus",
                    "renamed",
                    "replaced",
                    "corrupt"
                  ]
                },
                "norm": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "fileName": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "expected": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "detail": {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "type"
              ]
            }
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "artistId",
          "band",
          "planCount",
          "onDiskCount",
          "ok",
          "issues"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "reports"
  ]
}
```

Response 404: Not found

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {}
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ]
}
```
